arxiv-2307-14366.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Abraham Gale, Amélie Marian. Ranking functions that are used in decision systems often produce disparate results for different populations because of bias in the underlying data. Addressing, and compensating for, these disparate outcomes is a critical problem for fair decision-making. Recent compensatory measures have mostly focused on opaque transformations of the ranking functions to satisfy fairness guarantees or on the use of quotas or set-asides to guarantee a minimum number of positive outcomes to members of underrepresented groups.

pmc-10936365.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Prior work has shown that tamoxifen and tamoxifen-induced CreER activation can have off-target effects that should be controlled. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing and spirometry were performed at admission and discharge.
